summary: Tested the new SLD generator (backend + frontend). Backend: new suite test_sld_generator.py has 19 tests, all passing. With the existing suites that is 81/81 passing, so there are no regressions. Demo PDF is A3 landscape with 2 pages and a title block. Status, PDF in A3/A4/auto and report all work. Apply fills only empty fields and records auto_filled. Approve correctly returns 400 for missing data, no signer, ineligible signer and an invalid role. approved->stale->re-approve bumps the revision to 1, and unapprove resets to draft. Source/upload/clear_upload work. Frontend: all requested data-testids are present. The missing list, the disabled approve button and the toggle-all (1 vs 51 rows) work. Preview, A4/A3, report and demo all open the correct URLs. Approve shows 'Aprobată · name'. However, a CRITICAL data-loss bug wipes the approval and the uploaded schema on the next save.

minor.issue: When panel W is missing, the PDF prints 'S1: 10×[W lipsă] = 0 kWp'. This violates the 'no 0 kWp when data missing' requirement. Should print '[kWp lipsă]' when s['kwp'] is 0.

Items with ok=False (NECONFORM) do not block approval, because ready only checks missing+errors. The DEMO config itself shows 'Selectivitate (cascadă) INV 20 A < TG 40 A ≤ BMP 32 A — NECONFORM' (TG 40 A > BMP 32 A) and still reports ready=true and can be approved. Either move NECONFORM checks into errors or fix the DEMO values (e.g. TG 32 / BMP 40).
sld.approval holds a single object, so approving as verifier overwrites the designer approval. You cannot keep both a designer and a verifier approval at the same time.
If grid.supply is empty, a 'invertor monofazat pe racord trifazat' warning is shown. It assumes a three-phase grid when the supply type is unknown.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL DATA LOSS. form is {...item} loaded when the record is opened, and it includes the old `sld` object. persist() and the main Salvează do PUT /data/prosumator/{id} with the whole form. update_item does not strip `sld`, so the stale form.sld overwrites the DB. Reproduced in the UI: approve designer shows 'Aprobată' → click sld-refresh → 'Ciornă — neaprobată'. Upload PDF + select 'uploaded' → click sld-refresh → the upload is gone and the source is back to generated. Because of this, the 'stale' status can never appear in the UI; any save returns the record to draft.

issues: The diagram sits in the middle band; the top ~30% of the drawing area is empty, and the text is very small at A3 scale. Consider scaling or centering the drawing vertically.
sld-demo is an <a> wrapping a <Btn> (a button inside an anchor), which is invalid nested interactive markup.

action_items: CRITICAL: stop the generic PUT /api/data/prosumator/{id} from overwriting `sld`. In update_item, pop 'sld' for prosumator, like opis/snapshot (sld is managed only via the /sld/* endpoints). Alternatively, strip sld from the form in SldPanel.persist and ModulePage.save. Then retest: approve → Salvează și verifică keeps 'Aprobată'; changing a CEF field → 'stale'; the upload survives a save.
Fix sld.py:229 so it prints '[kWp lipsă]' instead of '= 0 kWp' when panel_w is missing.
Decide whether NECONFORM checks should block approval, and fix the DEMO TG/BMP values so the demo does not show a NECONFORM selectivity.
Consider storing separate approvals per role (designer and verifier).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_item: the prosumator branch pops opis/snapshot/snapshot_history but not sld. This is the root cause of the data-loss bug.

SldPanel.open(): window.open is called after await persist(). Popups can be blocked if the save takes more than about 5 s (transient user activation expires). Consider opening the window synchronously and then setting its location.
sld_unapprove does not check that the record exists (it returns ok for an unknown id).

success_rate.frontend: 85% (all elements/flows work, but approval/upload persistence is broken by the save overwrite)

seed_data_creation: Test records (TEST_ prefixed prosumator/clients/staff) were created and deleted. None remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run test_sld_generator.py (it creates its own TEST_ client, staff and prosumator from sld_demo.DEMO_REC). For the UI, set localStorage den_token and open /prosumator → edit-{id}. Regression check for the fix: approve, then click sld-refresh; the status must stay 'Aprobată'. Then change a CEF field and save; the status must become 'Aprobare anulată'.
rca of the issue: ModulePage.openEdit sets form={...item}, which includes sld from the list fetch. The /sld/{id}/approve and /source endpoints update sld in the DB, but form.sld stays stale. SldPanel.persist() (used by refresh, preview, report and approve) and ModulePage.save send the full form, and update_item does $set on it including sld. Result: the approval, upload and revision are reverted. Repro via API: GET the record, POST approve, PUT the old record → status=draft. Mitigation: data.pop('sld', None) in update_item for prosumator.
